entries.title: Moscow hit by largest Ukrainian attack since start of Russia's full-scale war
entries.snippet: A refinery and a shopping centre were burning after almost 200 Ukrainian drones struck an area to the south-east of the Russian capital.

entries.title: First Russian shadow fleet tanker enters Channel since Smyrtos boarding
entries.snippet: Forwarder, a Russian-flagged ship which left port in Primorsk last week, entered the Channel on Wednesday evening.

entries.title: Suspected gang leader shot dead in flower bouquet ambush at airport
entries.snippet: The gunmen concealed their weapons behind flowers and stuffed toys while waiting for the victim outside Guayaquil airport.

entries.title: Gunfire and explosions heard at Niger capital's airport
entries.snippet: Niger has been fighting a militant Islamist insurgency for a decade and in January suspected jihadists attacked the same airport.

entries.title: Lawyer in high-profile Ugandan treason case charged with related offence
entries.snippet: Uganda's military chief had boasted of "the hurt and pain" he would inflict on Erias Lukwago, who was arrested earlier this week.

entries.title: Bird flu kills more than 75% of baby seals on remote Australian island, study finds
entries.snippet: Scientists say 13,000 southern elephant seal pups on Heard Island have died of the H5N1 strain.

entries.title: Japan ramping up defence is 'critical' to prevent war, Defence Minister Koizumi tells BBC
entries.snippet: Japan needs to revisit the pacifist posture that has defined it since World War Two, Shinjiro Koizumi says.

entries.title: Apple to raise prices as AI boom pushes up chip costs

entries.snippet: The horse bolted and toppled over after the carriage driver stepped down to take a picture of the passengers.

entries.title: Lil Nas X says he's 'feeling better' after rehab and bipolar diagnosis
entries.snippet: The Old Town Road star was arrested last year for attacking police officers and later entered rehab.

entries.title: Status quo at Jerusalem's holiest site under threat as Israeli nationalists flout rules
entries.snippet: Israeli nationalists are increasingly flouting a convention on how faiths share the al-Aqsa mosque compound.

entries.snippet: In fiery exchange, judge sentenced him to three life sentences plus 25 years to life on four other charges, all running consecutively.

entries.title: The Ring and Lilo & Stitch actress Daveigh Chase dies aged 35
entries.snippet: Chase died from sepsis following a bout with meningitis in a Los Angeles hospital, her longtime manager told the BBC.

entries.snippet: Crown Princess Mette-Marit, who suffered from pulmonary fibrosis, will now spend several weeks recovering in hospital.

entries.title: Israel launches fresh strikes on Lebanon despite Trump criticism
entries.snippet: Speaking on Tuesday, Trump said Israel's PM Benjamin Netanyahu needed "to be more responsible with respect to Lebanon".

entries.title: Bystanders smash windows of private jet to rescue passengers after crash

entries.title: Report: Russia's nuclear-powered 'Skyfall' missile is dirty and dangerous
entries.snippet: MIT researchers think they've worked out exactly how Russia's Burevestnik nuclear-powered missile flies. "It's almost certainly a terrible idea," one analyst said. "But it's not an impossible idea."

entries.title: Trump signs agreement with Iran. And, the president's approval hits record lows
entries.snippet: Trump signed a preliminary agreement with Iran yesterday to end the war and open the Strait of Hormuz. And, the president's approval rating has hit a record low, according to a new NPR poll.

entries.title: The Obama Presidential Center will be dedicated Thursday. Here's what to expect
entries.snippet: The Obama Presidential Center's grand opening ceremony will be a star-studded event. The center's museum highlights the legacy of the former president, but it is not a traditional presidential library.

entries.title: As America turns 250, one museum makes history possible to touch
entries.snippet: Federal law requires most museums and other buildings to be accessible to people with disabilities. But access to what's actually inside is often still limited.

entries.title: What — and who — will be at the Great American State Fair? Here's a primer
entries.snippet: Several state governments have declined to participate in the 16-day event, though organizers say all U.S. states and territories will be represented by booths on the National Mall.

entries.title: Poll: Most Americans have the summer blues about Trump and the economy
entries.snippet: A new NPR/PBS News/Marist poll finds a record low share of Americans approve of President Trump's job performance and his handling of the economy heading into the summer before a key midterm election.

entries.title: The price of jet fuel is falling, but don't expect airfares to follow any time soon
entries.snippet: The average price of jet fuel has fallen to its lowest level since the beginning of the war with Iran. But aviation experts say the cost of airfare is likely to stay high, at least for now.

entries.title: Hegseth announces in Brussels a review of U.S. forces in Europe, and a 'NATO 3.0'
entries.snippet: U.S. Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth lashed out at NATO allies on Thursday, announcing a review of American forces in Europe, and calling for a reboot of the organization to turn it into a "NATO 3.0."

entries.title: All detainees from immigration facility 'Alligator Alcatraz' have been transferred
entries.snippet: All detainees at the detention center in the Florida Everglades, known as "Alligator Alcatraz," have been transferred to other facilities, the Department of Homeland Security said, citing concerns related to the hurricane season.

entries.title: Trump's economic approval rating hits new low, poll finds
entries.snippet: Some voting groups that Trump handily won aren't happy with his economic approach, including more thanhalf of white voters without a college degree.

entries.snippet: For an insider's perspective on the tensions between President Trump and Republicans in Congress, Amna Nawaz spoke with GOP strategist Doug Heye.

entries.title: All detainees from immigration facility 'Alligator Alcatraz' have been transferred, DHS says
entries.snippet: All detainees at an immigration detention center in an isolated airstrip in the Florida Everglades, known as "Alligator Alcatraz," have been transferred to other facilities, the U.S. Department of Homeland Security said, citing concerns related to the hurricane season.

entries.title: Takeaways from the G7: Trump's new attitude toward allies buoyed by their praise for Iran deal
entries.snippet: President Donald Trump is not known to be a fan of international gatherings of world leaders, but he changed his tune at this year's G7 summit at a French Alpine resort, where he was buoyed by support from his counterparts for his tentative agreement with Iran to end the war.

entries.title: WATCH: Trump tours Palace of Versailles before dinner with France's Macron
entries.snippet: On Wednesday night, the French president threw open Louis XIV's palace to his U.S. counterpart for a private reception, show and dinner marking America's 250th birthday.

entries.title: The private school choice boom leaves behind many kids in public school
entries.snippet: Soon, half of all American schoolkids will live in states that offer public money for a private education. Texas is the latest to join in, budgeting $1 billion to spend this fall on private school scholarships or homeschooling expenses.

entries.title: LIVE MAP: Track the path of Tropical Storm Arthur
entries.snippet: A disorganized cluster of storms that had been plaguing the Gulf Coast for days came together to form Tropical Storm Arthur on Wednesday — the first tropical cyclone of the season in the Atlantic basin.

entries.title: Georgia Republicans choose Collins for Senate and Jackson for governor, a mixed result for Trump
entries.snippet: Georgia Republicans delivered a split decision for Donald Trump in Tuesday runoffs, opting for the president's preferred U.S. Senate candidate but rejecting his choice for governor in favor of a billionaire first-time candidate who spent freely from his personal fortune to win th

entries.title: Indiana becomes the latest state to receive flexibility from Trump on federal education spending
entries.snippet: The Trump administration is giving Indiana more flexibility over how it decides to spend its federal grant money, the third state to receive such exemptions from the Education Department as it seeks to "return education to the states."

entries.title: The price tag of overcoming a Trump endorsement, and other takeaways from Tuesday's primaries
entries.snippet: Rick Jackson's campaign spent more than $100 million, largely out of his own pocket, to defeat Trump-endorsed Burt Jones in the Republican runoff for Georgia governor.

entries.title: Judge upholds the conviction of former Wisconsin judge Hannah Dugan for helping immigrant evade ICE
entries.snippet: A federal judge on Tuesday declined to overturn a Wisconsin judge's obstruction of justice conviction for helping a man evade immigration officers who showed up at a courtroom looking to detain him.

entries.title: DW
entries.snippet: News, Analysis and Service from Germany and Europe - in 30 Languages

entries.title: Niger security forces battle gunmen at airport
entries.snippet: Niger's security forces engaged in an hours-long shootout with gunmen at the nation's main international airport. No one has taken responsibility but Islamists are suspected of being behind the attack.

entries.title: Poland: Arrest after Russian artist and Putin critic killed
entries.snippet: Prime Minister Donald Tusk says Lublin police arrested a suspect in the fatal shooting of the Russian national and critical artist known as Semyon Skrepetsky. He said investigators were still seeking a "mastermind."

entries.title: NATO: US lashes out, alliance head says everything's fine
entries.snippet: US Secretary of Defense Pete Hegseth threatened NATO allies over lack of spending and tepid support for the war in Iran. Members say they are on the right path but need time as NATO boss Mark Rutte, claims all is good.

entries.title: Berlin summit brings out private equity protesters
entries.snippet: Activists gathered to protest the SuperReturn private equity summit in Berlin, saying the industry drives inequality, job cuts and rising costs as investors representing trillions of Euros gather to seek high returns.

entries.title: Nathaniel Brown: The left back Germany have been waiting for
entries.snippet: A strong option at left back is overdue for Germany. Nathaniel Brown is quickly becoming a star at the World Cup.

entries.title: Cuba approves economic reforms amid US pressure
entries.snippet: Cuba's Communist Party has signed off on a package of free market reforms. One member called the changes a response to "economic war," while the party said they were not a "deviation" from the socialist project.

entries.title: Germany news: 'Germany wants to be respected' - minister
entries.snippet: German Foreign Minister Johann Wadephul has criticized the UN after Germany failed in a recent bid for a Security Council seat. Meanwhile, German industrial employment levels are down to a decade low. DW has more.

entries.title: India news: Modi, Trump 'very close' to trade deal
entries.snippet: As the Indian and US leaders put on a friendly show on the sidelines of the G7 summit, a critical trade deal still hangs in the balance. Meanwhile, the Indian air force is helping secure the NEET-UG retests. DW has more.

entries.title: How a Belarusian exile vanished in waters held by Russia
entries.snippet: Former sports official Anatol Kotau was last seen boarding a private yacht in Turkey in 2025. DW and its partners investigated his journey to and disappearance in Russia-controlled "gray zone" waters in the Black Sea.

entries.title: Germany's foreign minister: 'European unity is decisive'
entries.snippet: German Foreign Minister Johann Wadephul, in an interview with DW, underscores the trans-Atlantic partnership, close cooperation with Poland, continued support for Ukraine and European unity.

entries.title: Russia, Ukraine trade strikes as Zelenskyy talks with Trump
entries.snippet: Ukraine hit Moscow's refinery while Kyiv was hit by Russian missiles. The attacks come as Zelenskyy intensified efforts to end the war.

entries.title: Trump, Pezeshkian sign deal to end Iran war, reopen Hormuz
entries.snippet: US President Donald Trump and Iranian President Masoud Pezeshkian have signed an initial agreement to extend the ceasefire for another 60 days and reopen the Strait of Hormuz. DW has the latest.

entries.title: What's in the 14-point US-Iran peace plan?
entries.snippet: US officials have released an interim agreement that ends fighting on all fronts for 60 days and sets out provisions for the reopening of the Strait of Hormuz.

entries.title: EU lawmakers approve new tougher migrant policy
entries.snippet: The EU is backing tougher migration policies that seek to ramp up deportations of failed asylum-seekers. Under the new legislation, EU states can establish "return hubs."

entries.title: Germany: Reports of antisemitism in 2025 remain high
entries.snippet: The Federal Association of Departments for Research and Information on Antisemitism (RIAS) recorded over 8,700 cases they classify as antisemitic hostility in 2025, many of which were connected with the State of Israel.

entries.title: EU, G7 pledge support amid DRC Ebola outbreak
entries.snippet: G7 leaders called for a "strong and coordinated response" to the latest Ebola outbreak. The EU's Ursula von der Leyen said that "health security is shared security." The recorded death toll in DRC is approaching 200.

entries.title: CRISPR gene-editing for crops: Precision tool or new risk?
entries.snippet: The EU has eased restrictions on crops developed using novel genetic techniques. While supporters say the technology could help farmers adapt to climate change, critics argue its effects remain poorly understood.

entries.title: Morocco: The 2030 World Cup is more than sports, it is a national project
entries.snippet: Hosting the 2030 World Cup is more than just a sporting event for Rabat. While the kingdom invests heavily in infrastructure and prestige projects, doubts and social conflicts grow alongside a sense of pride and hope.

entries.title: Diplomats and abuse — chipping at the shield of immunity
entries.snippet: Domestic workers who were mistreated by diplomats are often denied justice due to their abusers enjoying diplomatic immunity. But court rulings in the UK and Switzerland have paved the way for change.
